info.title: OpenMasu backend events and read reports
info.description: Limited HTTP surface, not all OpenMasu routes. No administration, SDK enrollment, privacy, dashboard, callback or outbound APIs. Contract wire 0.4.0 is independent. Admission is not calculation or exactly-once external delivery.

servers.description: Non-routable synthetic placeholder; operator supplies the real origin separately.

post.summary: Admit first-party backend events to the durable inbox

parameters.name: x-openmasu-timestamp-ms
parameters.description: Unix milliseconds within configured skew; safe integer required.

post.description: SHA256/HMAC covers exact bytes. Timestamp Unix milliseconds, nonce 22-128 base64url characters, signature 64 lowercase hex. Fresh nonce/timestamp/signature on retry; keep producer-scoped event_id and payload stable across types. Identical digest duplicates, differing digest conflicts. Timeout/500 may be result-unknown: inspect receipt state; no automatic client retry or end-to-end exactly-once promise.

202.description: Durable inbox admission; status pending. Worker may still reject event payload. Scheduling/report calculation is separate.

400.description: Malformed JSON, event count or envelope fields.

401.description: unauthorized: invalid HMAC, inactive key, timestamp or reused nonce.

403.description: Forbidden event/authority claim, mixed subject or inactive privacy scope.

429.description: Rate limited; back off before retry with a fresh signature/nonce.

500.description: Result may be unknown; do not manufacture a new event_id.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: Registered app in the authenticated tenant; missing, unknown and cross-tenant apps return the same 404.

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: Repeated values deduplicate and sort.

parameters.name: metric_definition_version
parameters.description: Exact saved definition version.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower calendar-date bound.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper calendar-date bound; from must precede to.

parameters.name: watermark_at_most
parameters.description: UTC evidence cutoff, not a claim that every upstream event arrived. Required for records.

parameters.name: difference_reason_code
parameters.description: Difference audit only: filter stored reason, never infer a cause. An unknown well-formed reason can return no rows.

parameters.name: supersession
parameters.description: Exclude same-scope replaced runs, or include immutable history.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Normal default 200/max OPENMASU_REPORT_MAX_ROWS (1000); CSV export default/max OPENMASU_REPORT_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS (200000).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque endpoint-specific keyset next_cursor; retain app, selection and watermark. No OFFSET or atomic multi-page snapshot claim.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Common stored-row projection; CSV has an empty value cell for undefined.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: true requires CSV; rejects export_limit_exceeded rather than truncating.

integrityVerdict.description: Server-assigned platform-integrity evidence. It is evidence only and does not independently determine attribution, fraud, or metric eligibility.

value_state.description: Absence is semantically present for v0.2.0 compatibility.

comparison_context.description: Saved aggregate-only meaning; null/unknown is not reconstructed.

late_input_update_state.description: Explicit late-input request state; not proof of upstream completeness.

payload.description: Event-schema validation occurs asynchronously before ledger persistence; 202 is inbox admission, not validation completion.

oneOf.description: Tenant/app/producer/receipt IDs and time are server-assigned. All records must share one installation anchor, or all omit it. Authority claims are forbidden.
